Elena — thanks for the documents, received and shared with PayOps. A couple of clarifications before I mark the vendor as active: 

1) PO / Remittance labeling: Our payments system requires the PO number to appear in the remittance field as PO:<PONUMBER> and the invoice identifier as INV:<INVOICENUMBER>. Example remittance string we prefer: "PO:67891 INV:2025-1023 RMT:Sunset-Supplies". Can you confirm your ERP can populate those fields on the invoice export?

2) Bank verification: for ACH activation we do a micro-deposit verification flow and also accept a bank letter. Both are fine — if you prefer micro-deposits, we will schedule them from PayOps; if you prefer to avoid micro-deposits, upload the bank letter to the vendor portal and reply here so I can reference it.

3) Invoice attachment / PDF naming: please include the company name and invoice number in the filename (e.g., Sunset-INV-2025-1023.pdf) to help our automated OCR.

I will loop in finance to schedule the micro-deposit (if you choose that), and Jordan will confirm when the PO mapping is created.

Best,
Irene Choi
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
